BiblicalUsage: Huppim is one of Benjamin's sons who goes down into Egypt with Jacob's household. His name returns in the chronicle of Benjamin's sons, in a list of men who became heads of families. Nothing more is told of him, and the lists are all that remain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Huppim is remembered because God counts the sons who go down into Egypt, and every name in the household matters to Him.
